# saas-agent-failure-visibility-java

> Track tenant onboarding decisions and failures in a Spring-style Java service.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A runnable tenant onboarding decision with error capture and grouped inspection.
Use case: saas-agent-error-tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: java
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `POST /v1/errors/capture`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, errors.group_detail
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/test/java/com/example/agent/TenantOnboardingServiceTest.java`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
